The Problem

Feedback from the wrong people is worse than no feedback

Generic opinions from people who don't understand your industry

Random feedback from non-experts leads to misguided product decisions and wasted development time.

Too expensive for early-stage builders — G2 and Trustpilot are for big companies

Traditional review platforms charge thousands, leaving indie builders without credible social proof.

No way to prove your product works for real professionals

Without verified reviews from industry experts, your product lacks the credibility needed to close deals.
